# Links

> Links (https://links.namansoni.in) is a free, open, no-ads link-in-bio
> platform: one fast page per person at https://links.namansoni.in/<username>
> with their links, mini descriptions, contacts and a profile photo —
> plus embeddable "widgets" (self-contained SVG cards) for GitHub
> READMEs, portfolios and docs. Made by Naman Soni
> (https://github.com/NamanSoni78), runs entirely on free tiers.

## Key routes

- `/` — landing page
- `/<username>` — public profile page (links, contacts, avatar)
- `/<username>/<widget>` — a public widget page (interactive HTML version)
- `/<username>/<widget>/embed` — the same widget as a bare, transparent
  iframe-able page
- `/api/embed/<widget-slug>` — the widget as a standalone SVG image
  (this is what Markdown embeds point at)
- `/widgets` — the signed-in widget builder
- `/llms.txt` — this file

## Widget embed image — query parameters

`GET https://links.namansoni.in/api/embed/<widget-slug>`

| Parameter | Type / range | Meaning |
|-----------|--------------|---------|
| `v`       | short tag    | Cache-buster. Every save mints a new `v`, so embeds refresh within minutes. Purely optional. |
| `width`   | 120–4096     | Scales the card to this width (height follows the aspect ratio). |
| `height`  | 120–4096     | Scales the card to this height (width follows). |
| `width` + `height` | both | Fits the card inside the box, centered on a transparent letterbox. The card is NEVER distorted. |

Default (no params): the card renders at its natural size (456 px wide,
height depends on content). Responses are CDN-cached for a day, so
custom resolutions cost the site nothing after their first hit.

Example:
`https://links.namansoni.in/api/embed/my-widget?v=1hsfq&width=300`
serves the widget 300 px wide.

Markdown usage:
`![My widget](https://links.namansoni.in/api/embed/my-widget?v=1hsfq)`

## Making a widget with AI (the interview protocol)

Links can turn a small JSON spec into a finished widget. If a user asks
you (an AI assistant) to help them make one, follow this contract:

1. Interview them first: 2–4 short questions about the purpose, tone
   and what to highlight (their links/contacts get pulled in live —
   don't invent URLs).
2. Then output a single fenced ```json code block shaped like:

{
  "name": "short widget name (max 60 chars)",
  "data": {
    "content": {
      "imageUrl": "",                      // optional https:// image URL
      "imageShape": "circle|rounded|square",
      "title": "up to 80 chars",
      "message": "up to 200 chars",
      "linkLabel": "button text (optional, max 40)",
      "linkUrl": "https://… (optional)"
    },
    "style": {
      "bgMode": "solid|gradient",
      "bgColor": "#rrggbb",
      "bgColor2": "#rrggbb",               // gradient end
      "gradientAngle": 135,                // 0-360
      "textColor": "#rrggbb",
      "accentColor": "#rrggbb",            // button background
      "borderColor": "#rrggbb",
      "borderWidth": 0,                    // 0-3
      "radius": 16,                        // 0-24
      "shadow": true
    },
    "typography": {
      "font": "sans|serif|mono|trebuchet|verdana|times|impact|comic",
      "titleSize": 26,                     // 16-40
      "messageSize": 14,                   // 11-18
      "bold": true,                        // bold title
      "uppercase": false,                  // uppercase title
      "align": "left|center"
    },
    "animation": "none|fade|rise|pop|float|pulse",
    "blocks": {                            // optional sections, in any order
      "order": ["text", "sites", "contacts"],
      "texts": [                           // up to 5 animated lines
        {
          "text": "up to 120 chars",
          "size": 15,                      // 11-22
          "bold": false,
          "animation": "none|fade|rise|pop|float|pulse|typing",
          "delayMs": 400,                  // 0-4000, plays after this delay
          "speedMs": 70,                   // typing: ms per character, 40-140
          "loop": true                     // typing: retype forever
        }
      ],
      "sites":    { "showFavicon": true, "showDesc": true, "limit": 0 },
      "contacts": { "showIcon": true, "limit": 0 }
    }
  }
}

Notes:
- "sites" lists the user's real Links-page links (favicon + mini
  description included); "contacts" lists their real contacts.
  `limit: 0` means all (caps: 10 sites, 6 contacts).
- "typing" animates character-by-character with a blinking cursor,
  like readme-typing-svg, after `delayMs`.
- Colors are `#rrggbb`; aim for strong text/background contrast.
- Everything is sanitized and clamped server-side, but do try to stay
  inside the stated limits.

3. Import — tell the user to open https://links.namansoni.in/widgets,
   choose "New widget" → "New with AI" → the "Use any AI" tab, and paste
   your whole answer. The import fills the widget automatically, gives
   them a live preview and a one-tap create, and they can customize
   anything afterwards in the visual editor.

## Policies

- Content is user-provided; each profile page belongs to its owner.
- Widgets are public by URL but kept out of search indexes.
- No trackers, no ads, no analytics.

Contact: https://github.com/NamanSoni78
